$comment: Shared by Blender generators (geometry aligned to cells) and the runtime facade shader. Surface type codes are written to COLOR_0.r as (code + 0.5) / 16. 'atlas' faces use the photographic tower facades (art/external/textures), mapped at the curtain floor height. 'fixture' faces pick their color from fixture_colors via COLOR_0.g; 'screen' faces are video screens with UVs normalized 0..1 over the screen.
